Choose the mounting position before the phone holder

Test the position with the parked car

Work out where the screen can be seen without obstructing the road, controls or airbags, and check applicable local mounting rules. Vent clips, dashboard pads and suction mounts require different surfaces. A heavy phone can pull on a weak vent, while a curved or textured dashboard may not suit an adhesive pad. Check removal instructions before sticking anything to trim.

Include the case in the fit check

Measure the phone with its normal case fitted. Confirm clamp width, access to buttons and cable clearance. Magnetic attachment and wireless charging are separate capabilities: check compatible case requirements, charging power and the car adapter supplied. For shared cars, easy adjustment may matter more than the strongest advertised magnet. Judge stability after fitting while parked, before relying on the mount.
